name: @pipeworx/mcp-dbpedia

tools.name: lookup
tools.description: DBpedia Lookup search — find entities by label or alias.

type.description: Restrict to a DBpedia type URI (e.g. Place, Person)

tools.name: sparql
tools.description: Execute a SPARQL query against the DBpedia public endpoint.

query.description: SPARQL query text. Also accepts `sparql` as an alias — the wikidata_sparql_query tool uses that name for the same argument.

tools.name: resource
tools.description: Fetch all triples about a DBpedia resource.

uri.description: Full resource URI (e.g. "http://dbpedia.org/resource/Albert_Einstein") or label (e.g. "Albert Einstein")

tools.name: abstract
tools.description: Fetch a prose summary for a topic label (e.g. "Eiffel Tower") using Wikipedia's REST summary endpoint as fallback; returns title, extract text, and source URL.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-dbpedia forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the dbpedia pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
